summary: AAP 2.6 installation modes: containerized (Podman on RHEL VMs or bare metal), Operator (OpenShift) and RPM, each with growth and enterprise tested topologies; the RPM installer was deprecated in 2.5, is supported on RHEL 9 through 2.6 for migrations and will be removed in 2.7.
questions: Which installation methods does AAP 2.6 support?
When will the RPM installer be removed?
